_about: LITERATURE_ASSERTED, like the native-contact golden set: these may gate a
proposal and explain one, never carry a numeric weight. Nothing here was
checked against its source in this build and every entry says so.
Terminology, enforced throughout the codebase: these are PARTNER PEPTIDES
forming BINARY COMPLEXES. Never 'dipeptide' -- that word means a two-residue
peptide and describes a completely different molecule.

lacticin_3147.claim: A two-component lantibiotic. LtnA1 binds lipid II and forms the complex that LtnA2 recognises; neither component kills alone.
lacticin_3147.why_this_case: The cleanest obligate case in the literature. A system that scores LtnA1 in isolation is scoring a molecule with no activity.
lacticin_3147.engagement_order: LtnA1 binds lipid II first; LtnA2 recognises the resulting complex.
lacticin_3147.citation: Two-component lantibiotic literature; class IIb bacteriocins for the related cases.

magainin2_pgla.claim: Xenopus skin antimicrobial peptides forming an antiparallel heterodimer in the membrane. Each is active alone; the combination is superadditive.
magainin2_pgla.magnitude_source: project addendum section 8; not read from a primary source by this system

conotoxin_lightning_strike_cabal.claim: A delta-conotoxin delays sodium-channel inactivation while a kappa-conotoxin blocks potassium efflux. The physiological effect belongs to the cocktail, not to any member.
conotoxin_lightning_strike_cabal.why_this_case: The purest illustration of the concept: the two components act on different channels, and neither one's mechanism predicts the combined effect. A single-peptide scorer has no way to represent this at all.

distinctin.claim: Natively heterodimeric, disulfide-linked antimicrobial peptide. The covalent link is part of the molecule rather than an engineering choice.

hnp1_homodimer.claim: Dimerization is required for activity. The partner is a second copy of the same peptide.
hnp1_homodimer.why_this_case: A homodimer, included because the partner requirement is identical in kind while the partner is not a different molecule. A module keyed on 'find the other peptide' misses this entirely.

incretin_dual_agonists.claim: The two activities are fusable into a single sequence. GLP-1/GIP gave tirzepatide; GLP-1/glucagon gave retatrutide. Oxyntomodulin is the natural dual agonist and the precedent for the whole approach.
incretin_dual_agonists.why_this_case: The CHIMERIC_CANDIDATE precedent, and the mode most likely to be proposed wrongly: two activities being desirable together does not make them fusable, and oxyntomodulin exists as evidence that this particular pair is.
incretin_dual_agonists.citation: Incretin dual- and triple-agonist development literature.
